closed_scope: 161 independently pinned native scene methods:49 glow layers/static or raw-string texture sources,eight optional spider-orientation presence/reflection/pose contexts,and15 always-true render predicates. Typed bridges require these native roots. Combat/scalar catalog unchanged;optional external reflection lifecycle and actual fallback retained.

exclusions.reason: Exact native render-admission query returns true unconditionally. No gameplay source,actor write or payload;native culling behavior preserved.

Exact native optional-pose context:presence/reflective lookups retain their ClassNotFound and NoSuchMethod fallbacks. The actual invoked zero-argument getter is getOrientation; the captured getRenderOrientation handle has no native GET reader. Normal/yaw/pitch queries feed local JOML math and the supplied PoseStack only. Authored field writes are renderer-owned caches,debugYaw,and visual scale;empty applyRotations and native preRender forwarding are retained. No Entity rotation/motion/size or damage/status/control write. Optional external initialization/getter behavior remains native and is not claimed pure; reflection exceptions log and return false exactly as authored.
